expect: two different studies: the multicopy-integration platform gave limonene 14.12 g/L and nerolidol 32.33 g/L in 5-L bioreactors (p11.L1-2, ref [16]); later optimisations gave (S)-limonene 22.8 g/L (p11.L15, ref [21], Table 2 22,800) and (E)-nerolidol 70.50 g/L (p11.L20, ref [24], Table 2 70,500). Not a contradiction, different strains and studies.
trap: reporting one pair as the only values, or calling the pairs inconsistent
